name: Bing Content Removal Tool

search.notes: Search Bing for the name with a city to find results that still point to removed listings.

steps: Confirm the listing page is gone or changed on the source site.
Open the Bing Content Removal Tool and sign in with a Microsoft account.
Choose page removal or outdated cache removal and paste the exact URL.
Submit and check the request status in the tool.
optout.notes: For pages already removed or changed at the source. For live pages with private info in Europe use bing-eu-delisting. Elsewhere use bing-report-concern.

verification_note: Tool URL answered on 2026-10-27 and redirected to the Bing sign-in page for the content removal tool. The page behind sign-in was not viewed.
